gold: Blastic plasmacytoid dendritic cell neoplasm (BPDCN) with polyradiculopathy

selector.rationale: The presence of violaceous cutaneous lesions (leukemia cutis) and a cell differential showing 98% atypical cells/blasts strongly support the diagnosis of leukemia.

rejected.label: Neurolymphomatosis
rejected.why: While nodular thickening and enhancement of the lumbosacral nerve roots are present, the overall clinical and laboratory findings better support a diagnosis of leukemia.

rejected.label: Intravascular Lymphoma
rejected.why: The presence of violaceous cutaneous lesions is not specific to intravascular lymphoma, and other findings do not strongly support this diagnosis.

rejected.label: Lymphomatous Meningitis
rejected.why: The cerebrospinal fluid analysis shows a predominance of atypical cells/blasts, which is more consistent with leukemia than lymphomatous meningitis.
